sections.heading: Data flows
paragraphs: We collect workforce profile and attendance data to deliver the contracted service. All customer employee data remains in India. The notice was approved on 2026-08-19.
The standard archive retains all personal data for ten years, including closed tenant exports, under the ISMS records policy.

sections.heading: Rights
paragraphs: Customers may correct records through the admin console. Requests for a summary of all employee data must currently be routed to account support; an employee self-service access channel is planned for 2027.

sections.heading: Contacts
paragraphs: The part-time privacy officer can be reached at privacy@hrflow.example.
